posts.author: Archeia
posts.body:
Jam Page
​
Graphics, music, and various other assets are essential for game development.
Now, on
itch.io
, where countless creators gather,
Gotcha Gotcha Games
, the developer behind the RPG Maker series, is hosting its very first asset contest!
Theme: "Spring"!​
We are accepting submissions in
Five Categories
:
Tilesets
Characters
Enemies
Other (System Assets)
BGM
Grand Prize:
One winner per category will receive a
Amazon gift card of 50,000 JPY!
We look forward to your submissions!
The available engines for contest submission are:
RPG Maker MZ (RPGツクールMZ)
RPG Maker MV (RPGツクールMV)
RPG MAKER UNITE
Please refer to the following material specifications for each:
MZ Specifications
MV Specifications
UNITE Specifications
- Tileset Category​
Submit a tileset for map creation.
Please upload one tileset sheet along with a screenshot showing its usage.
- Character Category​
Submit character assets such as walking sprites or map objects.
Please upload one character sheet along with a screenshot showing its usage.
- Enemies Category​
Submit enemy assets for battle scenes.
Please upload an image along with a screenshot showing its usage.
- Sound Category​
Submit audio assets such as BGM, SE, or ME.
Please upload a sample file that can be played for review. (*Note: You can submit up to
three
tracks for judging.)
- Other Category​
Submit system-related assets such as UI elements or icons.
Please upload an image along with a screenshot showing its usage.
By submitting an entry, you agree to the terms and conditions of this contest.
Please read them carefully before participating.
How to Submit:​
Post your submission on itch.io under
assets
tag.
Upload your assets as
free downloads
.
Each participant can submit
up to 3 entries per category
.
Required Tags:​
Make sure to include
the corresponding tag
for your entry.
Submissions without the required tags
will not be considered.
Tileset Category:
AssetCon_tileset
Character Category:
AssetCon_character
Enemies Category:
AssetCon_enemies
Sound Category:
AssetCon_sound
Other Category:
AssetCon_other
Submission Period:
February 27, 2025 – May 31, 2025
Results Announcement:
Expected in June 2025
Gotcha Gotcha Games will review and judge the entries.
The following content is
not allowed
:
Violations of any laws or regulations
Violent, discriminatory, or explicit content, or anything against public order and morality
Content that defames or harms individuals, companies, or groups, or violates privacy
Content that infringes on copyrights, trademarks, publicity rights, or any intellectual property rights
Content that does not align with the purpose of this contest
AI-generated content
Copyright & Intellectual Property:
All submitted works must be original creations by the participant.
If a winning entry is later found to violate copyrights or the contest rules, the award may be revoked even after the announcement.
Violation of Rules:
If a participant engages in any prohibited behavior, such as violating these rules, defaming other participants, or causing harm, their entry may be disqualified, even after winning.
Additional Notes:
The contest may be changed or canceled without prior notice.
If the participant is a minor, parental consent is required.
Submissions must comply with itch.io's terms of service.
We may request an email address for communication purposes.
